title: What Is Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD? Android Overview
subtitle: A short tour of an Android tower defense game built around fire, ice, lightning and earth.
description: What is Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD? A tour of this elemental tower defense game for Android: 100 maps, combos, fusion, relics, daily challenges and more.
card: What is Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD? A tour of the elemental tower defense game for Android: 100 maps, combos, fusion, relics and a daily challenge.

faq.q: Is Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD free to play?
faq.a: Yes, you can download it free on Google Play. The store has optional purchases such as Remove Ads, a VIP Pass and a Speed Boost, plus gem and gold packs, but the whole campaign can be played without paying.

faq.q: Do I need a Google account to play?
faq.a: No. Progress is saved on your device. You can back it up and move it to a new phone with a transfer code, so you never have to sign in to anything.

faq.q: How many maps does Tower Defense Kingdom: Idle TD have?
faq.a: The campaign has 100 maps, each with its own layout, plus endless mode, expeditions and a daily challenge for when you want something different from the main levels.
